title: Soro：面向塔吉克语的轻量级基础模型与聊天机器人
summary: Soro 是一系列专为塔吉克语设计的轻量级对话大语言模型，基于 Gemma 3 进行持续预训练和监督微调，在塔吉克语基准测试上显著优于基线模型，同时保持英语性能。支持 FP8/INT4 量化以适配边缘部署，已在教育领域试点。
summary_en: Soro is a family of Tajik-specialized lightweight conversational LLMs, built on Gemma 3 with continual pretraining and instruction tuning. It outperforms baselines on Tajik benchmarks while retaining English performance, and supports FP8/INT4 quantization for edge deployment in education.
